learning: Only PreToolUse, PostToolUse, UserPromptSubmit, and SessionStart support hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext. Other events (Stop, TaskCompleted, SubagentStop) can only output plain text (verbose mode only). Use HSO_EVENTS set to guard output format.

The hook passes tool_input with file_path key, but the internal harness engine uses file key. Must normalize file_path→file before calling decide() and recordToolCall(). Advisory rewrites (type=context) do NOT block the tool call — the original call still executes, so it must be recorded in state.
All harness exports used by .claude/hooks/harness-eval.mjs must be re-exported here — the hook imports from dist/index.js. Missing exports silently destructure as undefined.
